mapper.sql: id, username, username_key, nickname, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at, version, deleted_at, security_version, credential_version, login_name_version, password_changed_at, current_zone_period_id, pending_zone_id, pending_zone_effective_at, pending_zone_requested_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app.account_guard WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM app.app_user ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM app.app_user WHERE pending_zone_effective_at <= clock_timestamp() AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY pending_zone_effective_at, id LIMIT 100
SELECT recovery_state FROM app.account_guard WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app.account_guard SET recovery_state = 'ISOLATED', isolation_reason = 'SECURITY_LEDGER_MISMATCH', version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, revision, zone_id, tzdb_version, valid_from, valid_to, source FROM app.user_zone_period WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.user_zone_period (id, user_id, revision, zone_id, tzdb_version, valid_from, source) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{revision}, #{zoneId}, #{tzdbVersion}, #{validFrom}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.user_zone_period SET valid_to = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND valid_to IS NULL

UPDATE app.app_user SET current_zone_period_id = #{periodId}, pending_zone_id = NULL, pending_zone_effective_at = NULL, pending_zone_requested_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}

UPDATE app.app_user SET pending_zone_id = #{zoneId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pending_zone_effective_at = #{effectiveAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, pending_zone_requested_at = CASE WHEN #{zoneId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() END, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}

UPDATE app.app_user SET username = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, version = version + 1, login_name_version = login_name_version + CASE WHEN #{renamed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}

UPDATE app.app_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = clock_timestamp(), credential_version = credential_version + 1, security_version = security_version + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT value_boolean FROM app.system_config WHERE config_key = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' FOR SHARE
SELECT value_text FROM app.system_config WHERE config_key = 'SITE_NAME'
SELECT failure_count, locked_until FROM app.login_attempt WHERE username_key = #{usernameKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.login_attempt (username_key, failure_count, locked_until, last_failed_at, retain_until) VALUES (#{usernameKey}, #{failures}, #{lockedUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, CASE WHEN #{failures} > 0 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END, clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL '1 day') ON CONFLICT (username_key) DO UPDATE SET failure_count = EXCLUDED.failure_count, locked_until = EXCLUDED.locked_until, last_failed_at = EXCLUDED.last_failed_at, retain_until = EXCLUDED.retain_until, version = app.login_attempt.version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp()

SELECT FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE binding_digest = #{binding} AND create_key = #{key}

mapper.update: UPDATE app.captcha_challenge SET verify_key = #{key}, verify_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, state = #{state}, verification_data = #{material}, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint, state, http_status, result_code, result_summary::text AS result_summary FROM app.request_dedup WHERE scope_key = #{context.scope} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{context.key} AND expires_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.request_dedup ( scope_key, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, state, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{context.scope}, #{context.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{operation}, #{context.key}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING', clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL '1 day' ) ON CONFLICT (scope_key, operation, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET request_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.request_fingerprint, state = 'PROCESSING', http_status = NULL, result_code = NULL, result_summary = '{}', expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE app.request_dedup.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE app.request_dedup SET state = CASE WHEN #{code} = 'OK' THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END, http_status = #{status}, result_code = #{code}, result_type = 'ACCOUNT', result_summary = CAST(#{summary} AS JSONB), version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE scope_key = #{context.scope} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{context.key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.audit_event (actor_user_id, target_user_id, action, object_id, outcome, trace_id) VALUES (#{context.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{targetId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{action}, CAST(#{targetId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS TEXT), #{outcome}, #{context.traceId})

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.security_change WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND db_outcome = 'COMMITTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE app.security_change SET external_state = 'RESULT_SAVED', last_sync_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id = #{operationId}
